The '''Jakelian tuft-oak''' was a type of [[Tree/Legends|tree]]<ref name="Incredible">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref> that originated in<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|species=Jakelian tuft-oak|system=[[Jakelia system/Legends|Jakelia system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the [[Jakelia system/Legends|Jakelia system]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Its [[Wood/Legends|wood]] was used to decorate the hallways of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']].<ref name="Incredible" />
